gates.name: Pilot charter and participants
gates.evidence: Signed scope, named pilot users, authorised input classes and explicit pilot approval

gates.name: Private hosting and access boundary
gates.evidence: Selected local architecture; loopback-only application and alternate-port behavior verified; machine assurance and independent operational review open

gates.name: Production identity and role lifecycle
gates.evidence: Named local accounts, separate role permissions, fresh login and persistent revocation verified using generated synthetic users; human identity/OS account lifecycle not accepted

gates.name: Tenant isolation and authorisation
gates.evidence: Synthetic role/assessment boundaries, contributor exclusion and independent review guards verified; independent operational assurance open

gates.name: Evidence intake and parser assurance
gates.evidence: Approved isolated parser and scanning/quarantine process; operational assurance

gates.name: Encrypted storage and recovery
gates.evidence: Persistent encrypted checkpoint, atomic failure refusal, full mock restart and recovery verified. Owner deferred local host disk-encryption assurance for fictional-only UAT; not operational acceptance. Future cloud managed storage/key/backup encryption requires independent verification.

gates.name: Retention and lifecycle
gates.evidence: Synthetic maximum archive expiry verified; approved retention, deletion and backup lifecycle open

gates.name: Audit and operational response
gates.evidence: Audit verification on full lifecycle and recovery; external audit/anti-rollback/incident assurance open

gates.name: Privacy and stakeholder authority
gates.evidence: Approved privacy notices, consent/authority, minimisation, handling and deletion process

gates.name: Model governance
gates.evidence: Approved processing locality, model scope, reproducibility and human review assurance

gates.name: Scoring and assessor calibration
gates.evidence: Independent assessors, labelled cases, threshold/rounding/N/A decisions and acceptance

gates.name: Operational reliability and support
gates.evidence: Complete persistent mock lifecycle, restart/backup recovery and failure handling verified; independent local operations/availability acceptance open

gates.name: Pilot UAT and go/no-go
gates.evidence: Scripted complete local synthetic lifecycle test passed; actual independent human UAT, named cohort, defect closure and go/no-go remain open
